requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Allow users to create and edit their username alongside their email.
requirements.changes: Validate the actual username draft before sanitization. Both entry points now reject overlong/invalid drafts rather than silently saving a truncated or stripped identity. Basket keeps invalid text visible for correction and retains incomplete typing. Failed edits preserve the previous shared/persisted username. No backend identity reservation or new personal data collection was introduced.
requirements.verification: Extended actual-store restart regression tests and added persistence equality test; runtime execution pending founder Mac. git diff --check passed for changed Swift files.
requirements.remainingIssues: Public server uniqueness/moderation needs configured backend. Existing deterministic moderation is not comprehensive multilingual moderation. The app cannot establish a user’s actual legal name without a founder-approved privacy-preserving verification policy; no unsupported identity inference or legal-name collection was added.
